items.text: On Linux, Open Config opens a Settings window that changes one line of the config per edit.
On Linux, Ctrl+Shift+/ opens a Keyboard Shortcuts guide built from the live keybinds.
A restored pane's banner check now says whether the banner was saved before the restart.
On Linux, a pane nobody can see stops drawing and catches up when shown.
On Linux, closing a pane, tab or window is measured to give back everything it held.
